Yes — from CSV or a spreadsheet, mapped with you during onboarding. Products and open balances can come across at the same time.

tree: Is the credit ledger part of CRM?
It is its own module, but it reads and writes the same customer record, so a balance is never a separate lookup.

Yes. Role-based permissions decide who can view spend, edit the ledger or export customer data, per branch.
